slides.title: Story 1: Inflation Ran Hot
slides.body: BLS reported prices up 0.4% on the month (core +0.3%), above forecasts of 0.3% and 0.2%. No yearly rate was published because of missing data from the 2025 shutdown.

slides.title: Number of the Week: 0.4%
slides.subtitle: October CPI, monthly change (%)
slides.body: Actual vs forecast. Light bars are forecasts; outlets vary.

slides.title: Stories 2 and 3: Fed and Oil
slides.body: Fed Governor Waller said on Nov 10 he backs a December hike. Brent oil fell below $90 on Iran deal hopes, yet the 10-year yield was back above 5% by Nov 12.
